description: Agent team collaboration on a multi-layer feature spanning eBPF, Rust analyzers, frontend contracts, and integration tests.

agents.task: You own the analyzer interface contract. Write a brief spec for a new 'file-access-audit' analyzer: name, input event type, output event type, and configuration fields. Coordinate with the ebpf-kernel-engineer teammate to ensure your analyzer can consume the kernel enrichment data they're designing. Check in with the team periodically on progress.

You own the kernel enrichment strategy. Design the eBPF probe that captures file-access events (open/openat syscalls) and exports them via a ring buffer. Coordinate with the integration-testing-orchestrator to ensure your probe is testable with their harness. Check in with the team periodically on progress.

You own the integration testing plan. Define test cases for the file-access-audit feature: one for the eBPF probe (raw events), one for the Rust analyzer chain, and one for the frontend contract. Coordinate with the frontend-visualization-expert to align your test schema with their data contract. Check in with the team periodically on progress.

You own the dashboard data contract for the file-access-audit feature. Define the TypeScript types and component props needed to render file-access events on the timeline. Coordinate with the rust-framework-architect to ensure your schema mirrors their output event type 1:1. Check in with the team periodically on progress.
